# HEFEST REK-BYT

> HEFEST REK-BYT provides apartment and house repairs and renovations, from individual improvements to larger refurbishment projects.

The website presents renovation services, examples of completed work, information for clients, contact details, and the privacy policy. The main website is available in Czech and English.

## Website

- [Home page](/): Overview of renovation and repair services.
- [About the company](/#about): Company approach and information.
- [Services](/#services): Apartment, house, bathroom, kitchen, flooring, tiling, painting, and finishing work.
- [Portfolio](/#works): Examples of renovation and finishing work.
- [For clients](/#clients): How project planning and renovation work together.
- [Contact](/#contact): Contact options for discussing a renovation project.
- [Privacy policy](/#/privacy): Information about privacy and data processing.
